children.value: > Fact From Story: Afterward, Jordan said simply of his colleagues, “We put the question to them, they made a different decision.”

> > Fact From Story: Republicans dropped Rep. Jim Jordan on Friday as their nominee for House speaker, making the decision during a closed-door session after the hard-edged ally of Donald Trump failed badly on a third ballot for the gavel.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: When someone is no longer a nominee, they are no longer a candidate.

> Fact From Story: Republicans dropped Rep. Jim Jordan on Friday as their nominee for House speaker, making the decision during a closed-door session after the hard-edged ally of Donald Trump failed badly on a third ballot for the gavel.
> > Fact From Story: Jordan said simply of his colleagues, “We put the question to them, they made a different decision.”
> > > Fact From Story: The hard-charging Judiciary Committee chairman said House Republicans now need to come together and “figure out who our speaker is going to be.”
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: If someone needs to figure out who someone will be, it is because they do not know who it will be.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: A vote is a way of deciding something.
> Commonsense Knowledge: When someone is no longer a nominee, they are no longer a candidate.
